hints.title: Rotation Interval Scoring Ranges
hints.text: For each index i, determine the exact interval of shift steps k where nums[i] lands at an index greater than or equal to its value.

hints.title: Difference Array Boundary Marking
hints.text: A point is scored when (i - k + N) % N >= nums[i]. This simplifies to an interval of valid k values. Increment the start of this interval by 1 and decrement the end by 1 in a difference array.

hints.title: Prefix Sum Sweep for Maximum Score Blueprint
hints.text: Allocate diff array of size N. For each i, mark the interval [ (i + 1) % N, (i - nums[i] + N + 1) % N ]. Accumulate prefix sums across k from 0 to N-1 and pick k minimizing index among maximum scores.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def bestRotation(self, nums: list[int]) -> int:
        n = len(nums)
        diff = [0] * n
        for i, val in enumerate(nums):
            low = (i + 1) % n
            high = (i - val + n + 1) % n
            diff[low] += 1
            diff[high] -= 1
            if low >= high:
                diff[0] += 1
        best_k = 0
        max_score = -1
        curr = 0
        for k in range(n):
            curr += diff[k]
            if curr > max_score:
                max_score = curr
                best_k = k
        return best_k
```

complexity.notes: Difference array updates take O(1) per element; single linear prefix sum scan finds optimal k.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating array rotations takes O(N^2) resulting in time limit exceeded.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Difference array of size N captures score increments without full rotation arrays.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Translating inequality into interval boundaries and accumulating with prefix difference.
